beats.text: Men or women: who uses sex toys more? Guess.
Two national surveys asked over three thousand American adults about vibrators.
Fifty-three percent of women had used one.
And men? Forty-five percent. Most of them together with a partner. And users had something else in common.
They were more likely to look after their sexual health, like doing self-exams.
So it's not a secret-drawer thing. It's half the country. Both halves.

sources: Herbenick et al. (2009). Prevalence and characteristics of vibrator use by women in the United States. J Sex Med 6(7). 2,056 women 18-60: 52.5% lifetime use.

Reece et al. (2009). Characteristics of vibrator use by heterosexual men in the United States. J Sex Med 6(7). 1,047 men 18-60: 44.8% lifetime use; 91% of users used it with a female partner; users more likely to do testicular self-exams. Funded by Church & Dwight (Trojan). Via ScienceDaily 2009.
